A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 15-page versions of Rel-Zero, including supplementary Sections A–H. Pages 2–15 have identical extracted text and rendered content; changes are confined to the first page.

before.justification: v1 reports original patch-pair stability experiments, watermarking comparisons, component ablations, and supplementary runtime, robustness and feature analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and ablations in Section 5 and the supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: The VAE-based stable-pair identification, ViT features, MLP predictor, BCE objective and top-K watermark generation/verification procedures in Section 4 are identical.

E1.justification: COCO training, UltraEdit/MagicBrush evaluation and three-dataset uniqueness analysis are unchanged. Both versions cover the same regeneration, global/local editing and distortion scenarios, including supplementary Section D.

E2.justification: DWT-DCT, Robust-Wide, VINE, ConZWNet and FGPCET retain identical participation in the main and supplementary comparisons. No comparator is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and supplementary Sections F–G retain identical sample allocations, image resolution, model settings, editing parameters and evaluation procedures, including TPR at 0.1% FPR.

E4.justification: Top-K and patch-size sensitivity, component ablations, uniqueness/collision analysis, and supplementary PCA, feature-stability, corruption and visual analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: The correlation statistics and significance annotations are unchanged. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval or error-bar reporting is added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are identical. For example, main Table 1 retains Rel-Zero TPRs of 85.13% for regeneration and 97.43% for ControlNet-Inpainting at 0.1% FPR; supplementary results also match.

T1.justification: The relational-invariance reasoning, mathematical definitions and equations in Sections 3–4 and supplementary Sections B, E and F are unchanged. No assumption, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same scientific claims about patch-pair invariance, relational zero-watermarking, robustness against editing and preservation of image fidelity.

C2.justification: Explanations of relational stability, VAE suitability, robustness, uniqueness and architectural effects are identical. No applicability boundary, limitation or failure condition is newly stated or revised.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and a GitHub link to JerCCC7/Rel-Zero at the end of the abstract; v1 provides no code-access link. Other implementation details are unchanged. The PDFs do not verify repository contents or functionality.

R1.justification: The same 45 references and related-work discussion are retained, with unchanged novelty positioning relative to embedding-based and zero-watermarking methods.

P1.justification: A code-availability sentence is appended to the abstract, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, terminology, headings and section order are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added repository link slightly changes first-page text spacing, alongside the updated margin stamp. All figures, tables and captions remain unchanged, and pages 2–15 render identically.

improvement.justification: The repository pointer supplies code-access information absent from v1, modestly improving implementation discoverability. This is a limited documentation improvement: the scientific content and appendix evidence are unchanged, and the PDFs alone cannot establish the linked code's completeness or usability.
